test_title: PYST 17: SSC CHSL 2023 - English (Held On: 08 Aug, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate idiom for the underlined segment in the following sentence.**

We should protect ourselves from **__jealous__** people.
solution: The correct answer is** "Green-eyed."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **"Jealous"** means feeling upset or angry because you think that somebody you like or love is showing interest in somebody else. (किसी प्रिय व्‍यक्ति का किसी अन्‍य व्‍यक्ति के प्रति झुकाव के कारण परेशान या क्रुद्घ; ईर्ष्यालु) • **Example**: *Tarun seems to get **jealous**__ whenever Sarita speaks to another boy!* • **"Green-eyed"** is an idiom that means being jealous or envious of someone. (किसी से ईर्ष्या या द्वेष करना) __ • **Example**: *I want to protect her from **green-eyed**__ people.* • This idiom comes from the idea that someone who is jealous has green eyes, which is not actually true. • The sentence is saying that we need to protect ourselves from jealous people, so using the idiom "green-eyed" is appropriate. • The correct answer is Option 4. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • **Option 1, "High-spirited," **means being energetic or enthusiastic. (ऊर्जावान या उत्साही होना) • **Option 2, "Any Tom, Dick or Harry,"** means anyone. (कोई भी) • **Option 3, "One trick pony,"** means someone who has only one skill or talent. (कोई ऐसा व्यक्ति जिसके पास केवल एक ही कौशल या प्रतिभा हो) 3e:T769, The correct answer is **"found everywhere in a huge amount."**
